title: Triage's inbox claim is a deterministic effect the agent keeps skipping — the host should perform it
summary: 3 of ~45 recent cycles (1647, 1671, 1689) hit GATE_CONTRACT_REJECTED [missing_effect] declared effect inbox-claim at triage: the agent committed its top_n but never ran `evolve inbox-mover claim <id> <cycle>`. Each recovered on correction 1/2 (one extra triage dispatch and a full prompt's tokens); none sealed FAIL, but a correction budget spent here is one a real contract miss cannot use.
root_cause: The claim is deterministic — move the committed item's file to processing/cycle-N under the ADR-0074 claim floor — yet it is delegated to the LLM and only verified after the fact by the contract gate's declared-effect check (rule 5: deterministic work belongs in code, not a prompt).
fix: After triage's deliverable verifies, the host performs the claim for each committed id through inboxmover.Claim (the same floor; an ErrConsoleRouted refusal surfaces exactly as the triage FAIL it is today). The declared effect stays as the verification the host's own action satisfies; the persona's claim step becomes advisory. Keep it transactional with the commit: a crash between the commit and the claim must be recoverable by the gate's re-check.
acceptance: A triage that commits top_n without running the claim command no longer produces missing_effect inbox-claim: the host claims each committed id, and the gate's effect check passes on the host's move.
A console-routed committed id is refused by the same claim floor and surfaces as today's triage refusal (no new failure mode).
Replay: the cycle-1689 triage-report + inbox state claims lost-ship-closeout-universal-landing-witness with zero corrections.
notes: Filed from the console 2026-09-26 during wave 7 (research F36 candidate). Evidence: runs/cycle-{1647,1671,1689}/signals.ndjson (grep missing_effect). Console-owned by kind (pipeline-*).
consumed_by: F36 (fix/host-performed-claim): before every review, core.Orchestrator.review runs deliverable.HostEffects on the gate's own ReviewInput. That performs the declared inbox-claim (inboxmover.ClaimPending, ADR-0074 floor) from the same {check, perform} registry the gate verifies with. Persona Step 0a.4 is advisory. All three acceptance criteria are pinned: zero-correction acceptance and the console-routed refusal by deliverable TestDeclaredEffects_HostClaim, and the 1689 shape by that test plus core TestRunCycle_EveryReviewPerformsHostEffectsFirst. See ADR-0100 amendment 10 and docs/incidents/2026-09-26-triage-claim-left-to-the-agent.md.
